info.title: JARVIS Dex Connector
info.description: Governed access to the JARVIS dex (JD/JNL). Privilege ladder via x-jarvis-token: READ -> PROPOSE -> DRAFT -> COMMIT -> OVERRIDE. Propose meaning; the connector derives JNL, class, tier, owner, timestamps and validates (GL6/GL12). Files in git stay truth; approved entries reconcile to files automatically.

post.description: Single endpoint, tool-dispatched. READ tools: jd_lookup {term}, jnl_resolve {jnl}, jd_list {class?, tier?, status?, type?, tag?, limit?}, jd_graph {jnl}, jd_diff {name, domain, system, type, ...}, dex_status {}. PROPOSE tool: jd_propose {name, domain, system, type, definition, purpose, tags?, related?, source?} — stages a proposal for Raven's approval; JNL is derived, never supplied.

args.description: Tool arguments. For jd_propose: name (required), domain (e.g. PROJ), system (project code e.g. DEO), type (JGPP|JIP|JD|BIO), definition, purpose, tags (array), related (array of JNLs, optional).

200.description: Tool result. ok=true with tool-specific payload.

403.description: Tool requires a higher tier than the supplied token.

423.description: Dex is HALTED (ZEUS emergency override). Writes frozen.
